patterns: hello is this the electricity chatbot
responses: Hello! I'm the GridWise assistant. I can help you report a fault, check outage information, answer billing questions or share electricity-saving tips. What do you need?
Goodbye! Stay safe and thank you for contacting the utility.
You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with?

patterns: how do i report a power cut
power is off in my street
electricity went off and has not come back
our lights are off and have been for hours
there is a blackout in my suburb
i want to report that the power is off
responses: I'm sorry about the power cut. I've logged an outage report for your area (ticket {ticket}). First check that your own circuit breaker has not tripped. Please tell me your street or ward so the team can be dispatched.

patterns: when will the power be back
how long will the power be off
when will the lights come back on
what time will power be restored
how long is the maintenance outage
is my area affected by load reduction
when is the next scheduled outage
responses: Planned maintenance and restoration times are published by the utility for each area. Give me your ward or suburb and I will pass your query to the control room (ticket {ticket}). For live updates, check the utility's official notices.

patterns: i want to query my account
how do i pay my electricity bill
i did not receive my statement
my prepaid token did not load
why is my account so high
i paid but it still shows owing
where can i buy prepaid electricity
i have a question about my statement
how do i buy electricity units
the amount i owe is incorrect
responses: I can help log a billing query (ticket {ticket}). Please have your account number and the date of your last payment ready. A billing officer will review the account. Prepaid customers should keep their token receipt.

patterns: my prepaid meter will not accept the token
i think my meter is faulty
prepaid meter is not taking units
responses: I've logged a meter fault (ticket {ticket}). Please do not open or repair the meter yourself. A technician will inspect it. Note your meter number if you can.

patterns: street lights are off on my road
no lights on the road at night
the light on our road is out
street lights not coming on at night
street light stays on all day
the road is dark because the lights are off
responses: Thank you for reporting the street light (ticket {ticket}). Please tell me the street name and the nearest landmark so the maintenance crew can find it.

patterns: a tree fell on the power lines
wire fell down and is sparking
a pole has fallen on the road
there is smoke coming from the transformer
a live wire is lying on the ground
electric pole is broken and dangerous
responses: SAFETY FIRST: stay at least 10 metres away from fallen or damaged lines and keep other people and animals away. Do not touch anything in contact with the line. I've flagged this as HIGH urgency (ticket {ticket}). Please also call the utility's emergency number: [insert emergency number].

patterns: tips to reduce my electricity usage
how do i lower my bill
what appliances use the most power
how can i help during peak demand
can i get tips to use less power
ways to cut my power usage
how do i reduce peak hour usage
advice to save energy at home
how can i lower electricity use
what can i do to use less electricity
responses: Tips: (1) switch off geysers outside the morning and evening peaks, (2) use LED lighting, (3) run heavy appliances off-peak, (4) unplug idle electronics, (5) use a timer on the geyser. Reducing use during peak hours helps the whole grid.

responses: You can reach the utility's customer service office during working hours: [insert contact details]. This chatbot is available 24 hours a day.
